title: CraftablesZ
description: Expands your world with 6 recipes for uncraftable items.
body:
# CraftablesZ
[![Download on Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-Datapack/Mod-1bd96a?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&logoColor=white)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/craftablesz)[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Join-Andy71_Discord-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/ETzFRjAFSZ)

Bring new progression paths to your Minecraft world with **CraftablesZ**! This mod adds **6 custom crafting recipes** for some of the rarest and most valuable items in the game. Instead of relying entirely on luck, exploration, or rare mob drops, you can now work toward these items through resource gathering and crafting.

## Recipes

### 🔱 Trident

Craft a **Trident** using **Prismarine Shards**, a **Diamond**, and **Prismarine Crystals**.

### 🗝️ Trial Key

Create a **Trial Key** using **Copper Blocks**, **Copper Ingots**, **Tuff**, and **Lanterns**.

### 🏆 Totem of Undying

Craft a **Totem of Undying** using **Emeralds**, **Gold Ingots**, a **Golden Apple**, and a **Hay Bale**.

### ⚠️ Ominous Trial Key

Upgrade a **Trial Key** into an **Ominous Trial Key** using **Redstone**, a **Ominous Potion**, **Tuff**, and **Oxidized Copper**.

### 🧪 Bottle o' Enchanting

Brew your own **Bottle o' Enchanting** using **Gunpowder**, a **Glass Bottle**, **String**, **Rotten Flesh**, and a **Bone**.

### 🍎 Enchanted Golden Apple

The legendary **Enchanted Golden Apple** can now be crafted using **4 Gold Blocks**, **4 Diamonds**, and **1 Golden Apple**. The recipe is expensive enough to keep the item valuable while finally making it renewable.

## Why Use This Datapack / Mod?

Many rare Minecraft items are locked behind random chance, difficult structures, or rare mobs. **CraftablesZ** offers balanced crafting alternatives that reward dedication, resource gathering, and long-term survival progression.

Whether you're playing a normal survival world, a multiplayer server, a skyblock map, or a custom modpack, these recipes provide more freedom while maintaining game balance.

## Features

* **6 custom crafting recipes**
* **Survival-friendly progression**
* **Balanced crafting**
* **Perfect for singleplayer and multiplayer servers**
* **Maintains the value of rare items through expensive recipes**
* **Simple and lightweight**

## Perfect For

* Survival players
* Multiplayer servers
* Skyblock worlds
* Vanilla+ modpacks
* Players who want renewable rare items

## Final Notes

If you've ever wanted a reliable way to obtain **Tridents**, **Totems of Undying**, **Trial Keys**, **Bottle o' Enchanting**, or even the iconic **Enchanted Golden Apple**, this mod is the perfect addition to your world.

Gather resources, invest time, and craft some of Minecraft's most sought-after treasures!
